title: Paid Holidays

eligibility.who: Full-time (1 day's pay) and part-time (4 hours' pay) employees present on the last scheduled day before and the first scheduled day after the holiday

text:
It Company recognizes the following holidays:
- New Year's Day
- Memorial Day
- Independence Day
- Labor Day
- Thanksgiving Day
- Christmas Day
When holidays fall or are celebrated on a regular workday, eligible full-time employees will receive one (1) day's pay at their regular straight-time rate; part-time employees will receive four (4) hours pay at their regular straight-time rate, Eligible employees who are called in to work on a holiday will receive an additional day off at the option of the Company.
If a holiday falls within an eligible employee's approved vacation period, the eligible employee will be paid for the holiday (at the regular straight-time rate) in addition to the vacation day.
If a holiday falls within a jury duty or bereavement leave, the eligible employee will be paid for the holiday (at the regular straight-time rate) in addition to the leave day, or the eligible employee will receive an additional day off at the option of the Company.
- Holidays will not be paid to employees on any type of unpaid leave.
- An employee must be present at work on his or her last scheduled day prior to the holiday and the first scheduled day after the holiday to receive holiday pay.
- Part-time employees will receive pro-rated holiday pay of 4 hours.
